data.notes: Search budget of 20 used. E53 pre-facelift (to 2003) not returned since not sold in 2005. X5 M variants included as variants of X5. Some power outputs only from third-party sites as noted.

corrections.evidence: BMW technical data sheet (valid from 04/2004) and motor1 test 'BMW X5 4.4i im Modelljahr 2004': 4.4i V8 N62B44, 235 kW / 320 PS. Also https://de.motor1.com/reviews/170535/bmw-x5-44i-im-modelljahr-2004-edelmann-mit-baren-kraften/

ADAC X5 4.8is Automatic (04/04-11/06): Länge 4667, Breite 1925, Höhe 1688 mm; BMW press data sheet valid from 04/2004 (press.bmwgroup.com T0006517DE/23879) also lists 4.8is 4667/1925/1688. Variant currently inherits generation height 1715.

auto-data.net and fastcarcheck list the 218 PS 3.0d (incl. Steptronic) for 2003-2006; used listings show 218 PS 3.0d with first registration 11-12/2006. The ADAC 10/05 cut-off is only one catalog entry split (ADAC itself gives E53 series end 11/06). Not manufacturer-confirmed; medium confidence.
Bimmertoday/Paultan on X5 LCI launch 2010: xDrive35i 306 PS (400 Nm).
Bimmertoday: xDrive50i 'trägt den 407 PS starken V8-Biturbo' (Wikipedia rounds to 408 PS; 300 kW = 407.9 PS, BMW DE typically states 407).
X5 M (E70) 4.4 V8 biturbo S63: 408 kW / 555 PS, 680 Nm (autobild, zeperfs, ultimatespecs agree).
Autobild F15: 4.4-l V8 biturbo xDrive50i with 450 PS and 650 Nm; mobile.de agrees.
auto motor und sport / vehiclesizes.com: X5 M F85 4880 x 1985 x 1754 mm, trunk 650-1870 l (autoevolution press-style 4879/1984). No BMW press sheet found.
BMW M: 4.4-litre V8 M TwinPower Turbo, 423 kW (575 hp), 750 Nm.

missing.detail: E70 (Vor-Facelift) xDrive35d (Diesel, 210 kW/286 PS, 09/08-04/10, ADAC https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/bmw/x5/e70/215284) and earlier 3.0sd (286 PS); trunk 620/1750 l. Also xDrive30i/xDrive48i names after 2008 renaming.
F15 sDrive25d / xDrive25d (218 PS, rear-drive sDrive variant) and xDrive35i (306 PS) not listed as variants; same body/trunk 650/1870 l.

E70 LCI / F15 combined variant 'xDrive30d / xDrive40d' hides different powers: E70 LCI 30d 245 PS / 40d 306 PS; F15 30d 258 PS / 40d 313 PS (bimmertoday, autoevolution, mobile.de). Consider splitting variants.

verification.notes: Confirmed: E53 4667/1872/1715/2820, 465/1550 (BMW 04/2004 data sheet per search summary, ADAC), 4.4i height 1707, 4.8is width 1925 and 360 PS, 3.0i 231, 3.0d 218; E70 4854/1933/1766/2933, 620/1750 (ADAC xDrive35d entry also 620/1750; ADAC lists height 1739 for 35d, likely without roof rails - not treated as contradiction); E70 X5 M 4851/1994/1764, 620/1750; F15 4886/1938/1762/2933, 650/1870; xDrive40e 500/1720 and 313 PS; F15 M50d 381 PS. Not independently checked: E70 pre-facelift engine powers, E70 LCI 1776/4857 beyond one third-party hit, M50d E70 width 2010. F85 values are from third-party sources (ams, vehiclesizes) as no BMW press sheet was found. 13 of 20 searches used. [Übernahme: 3 Korrektur(en) verworfen – nur vehiclesizes.com, keine Hersteller-/ADAC-Quelle]
